sequence.cn: 不管在哪，总有一个显眼包。
sequence.py: Bùguǎn zài nǎ, zǒng yǒu yí ge xiǎn yǎn bāo.
sequence.en: No matter where you are, there's always an "attention-grabber".

sequence.cn: 显眼，就是特别引人注意；包，是对某种人的可爱叫法。
sequence.py: Xiǎn yǎn, jiùshì tèbié yǐn rén zhùyì; bāo, shì duì mǒu zhǒng rén de kě'ài jiàofǎ.
sequence.en: 显眼 means very eye-catching; 包 is a cute way to name a type of person.

sequence.cn: 显眼包，就是那个走到哪，都要成为焦点的人。
sequence.py: Xiǎn yǎn bāo, jiùshì nà ge zǒu dào nǎ, dōu yào chéngwéi jiāodiǎn de rén.
sequence.en: A 显眼包 is the one who becomes the center of attention wherever they go.

sequence.cn: 我们这群朋友里，小胖就是头号显眼包。
sequence.py: Wǒmen zhè qún péngyou lǐ, Xiǎo Pàng jiùshì tóuhào xiǎn yǎn bāo.
sequence.en: In our group of friends, Xiao Pang is the number-one attention-grabber.

sequence.cn: 别人拍照都安安静静，他偏要跳起来比耶。
sequence.py: Biéren pāizhào dōu ān'ānjìngjìng, tā piān yào tiào qǐlái bǐ yē.
sequence.en: Others pose quietly for photos, but he insists on jumping up flashing a "V".

sequence.cn: 聚会上，他一个人就能逗得全场哈哈大笑。
sequence.py: Jùhuì shàng, tā yí ge rén jiù néng dòude quánchǎng hāhā dàxiào.
sequence.en: At a gathering, he alone can get the whole room laughing out loud.

sequence.cn: 有人说，显眼包太爱出风头了。
sequence.py: Yǒu rén shuō, xiǎn yǎn bāo tài ài chū fēngtóu le.
sequence.en: Some say the 显眼包 loves the spotlight too much.

sequence.cn: 可是每次气氛尴尬，大家都盼着小胖出现。
sequence.py: Kěshì měi cì qìfēn gāngà, dàjiā dōu pànzhe Xiǎo Pàng chūxiàn.
sequence.en: But whenever the mood gets awkward, everyone hopes Xiao Pang will show up.

sequence.cn: 原来，显眼包不是爱出风头，是想让大家开心。
sequence.py: Yuánlái, xiǎn yǎn bāo bú shì ài chū fēngtóu, shì xiǎng ràng dàjiā kāixīn.
sequence.en: It turns out, the 显眼包 doesn't crave the spotlight — they just want to make everyone happy.
